ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 80% of the visible surface, with a high-contrast low-intensity (black) region localized at the central notch and peduncle interface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white fields covering the lateral lobes; a central, symmetrical low-intensity black anchor at the notch; small localized dark pixel clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the central lobe division; pixel-depth of the notch is roughly 15-20% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward sweep; leading edges exhibit broad convexity; trailing edges follow a generally linear trajectory with minor terminal concavity.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct symmetrical black pigmentation pattern surrounding the median notch, contrasting sharply against the white ventral background.
